name: raycast-ai-usage
title: AI Usage
description: See your ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Antigravity usage limits across every account, from Raycast or the menu bar
author: TechSupportz

commands.name: view-usage
commands.title: View AI Usage
commands.description: View ChatGPT, Claude Code, and Antigravity usage limits

commands.name: menu-bar-usage
commands.title: AI Usage in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: AI Usage
commands.description: Show your chosen account's 5-hour or session limit in the menu bar

preferences.name: showUsageUsed
preferences.title: Usage Display
preferences.label: Show usage used
preferences.description: Show the percentage used instead of the percentage left for all accounts and usage windows

preferences.name: showCodex
preferences.title: Providers
preferences.label: Show ChatGPT limits
preferences.description: Read ChatGPT usage for every account signed in with codex-auth

preferences.name: showClaudeCode
preferences.label: Show Claude Code limits
preferences.description: Read Claude Code usage from its stored credentials

preferences.name: showAntigravity
preferences.label: Show Antigravity limits
preferences.description: Read Antigravity usage from the running Antigravity app, IDE, or agy CLI

preferences.name: showAntigravityClaudeGpt
preferences.label: Show Antigravity Claude/GPT limits
preferences.description: Include Antigravity's Claude/GPT model limits alongside Gemini limits

preferences.name: showResetTime
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.label: Show time until reset
preferences.description: Show how long until the limit resets next to the percentage, e.g. 58% · 2h 3m

preferences.name: menuBarProvider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Pick the provider to show as the menubar icon.

preferences.name: menuBarAccountName
preferences.title: Account
preferences.description: Pick a specific account when a provider has multiple.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
